name: Bruce Italian 1828
description: Reverse-contrast titling capitals with heavy horizontal strokes, thin stems and matching figures, from George Bruce’s 1828 specimen.
observed: Directly traced ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ,’;:.-!$1234567890 from English Italian on unnumbered PDF page 127 of the 1828 specimen.
reconstructed: No inferred visible characters. Lowercase input aliases the capitals. Blank spaces and digital spacing are new. A measured rigid rotation corrects page tilt; source dimensions and proportions are preserved.

sources.title: A specimen of printing types, and ornaments cast in the letter-foundry of George Bruce (1828), English Italian; unnumbered leaf, PDF page 127
sources.rights: 1828 United States publication; historical artwork is public domain by age. New York Public Library copy digitized by Google, distributed by HathiTrust and mirrored by Circuitous Root. A faithful scan of the historical page, not a modern digital typeface.

revival.author: Harold Lehmann
revival.notes: Native PDF image retained. A quarter-turn and measured 4.891-degree rigid rotation produce the reading image. See reference/acquisition.json and source/rows.json.

character_set_notes: Complete historical capitals-only alphabet, all ten figures and the currency/punctuation printed with it. Lowercase aliases capitals. Unsupported modern symbols are omitted.
